warnings: All four truss elevations are one section sheet; each truss's members share one callout (top chord, bottom chord, verticals, diagonals). The printed symbol before 100x50 is a slashed rectangle with the words 'rectangular tube' — designation RHS, print kept in printed_as. T1 is 3.2 mm wall; T2/T3/T4 are 2.3 mm.

The elevations print no grid markers; their panel chains are recorded in the grid master as floating chains ('edge' ends). Span totals agree with the S-05 plan (T1 8.00 = grid 1-3, T3 10.00 = A-D, T2 4.00 = 2-3, T4 6.50 = C-E); positions live on the S-05 roof_frame_plan elements.
Eave overhang lengths are not printed on these elevations (S-05 dimensions them at 1.00); left off the spec.
อะเส 2C-150x50x20x3.2 is labelled under every truss; recorded once as an unmarked steel beam spec (element_id null, element_name_assigned อะเส) matching the S-04 wall-plate plan.
